name: read_history_source
title: Read a source of the project history
description: Read one source a search_history hit named (a team message, a closed question or a document; cards and notes: get_task), in lines. A source you may not read gives not_found, like a missing one.

source_id.description: The source_id of a search_history hit.

project_key.description: Project key; defaults to the project of this session.

commit.description: A document only: the commit the hit named. history_source_changed: the stored copy is newer, search again.

annotations.title: Read a source of the project history
